It's likely that the track was untitled at this point, using the beat name as a placeholder, as Consequence stated he wrote the chorus for Ye.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2
description: The first adidas Yeezy 350 V2 release of 2019 gets colored up in a pale blue/green hue for a clean, neutral upper incorporating a semi-translucent vent at the lateral side that matches up with the translucent outsole. This ‘Hyperspace’ edition features a flexible Primeknit upper and full-length Boost cushioning—both iconic features of the Yeezy 350 V2 sneaker. This shoe released March 2019 exclusively in select cities in Africa, the Middle East, India and Asia Pacific.

title: YEEZY 500 HIGH
description: The adidas Yeezy 500 High ‘Wakaran’ showcases neutral beige tones on a flexible elastane upper, equipped with a comfortable padded collar and reinforced with suede and leather overlays. Reflective piping delivers added visibility in low-light conditions. Progressively darker shades of grey distinguish the podular adiPRENE+ midsole and rubber outsole, featuring a wavy traction pattern for optimal grip. The exterior is stripped of distinguishing logos and trademarks, relegating the sneaker’s branding elements to the sockliner instead.

title: YEEZY SLIDES KIDS
description: The 2022 reissue of the adidas Yeezy Slide Kids ‘Bone’ applies a neutral ivory finish to a slip-on built with injected EVA foam, offering lightweight durability and a comfortable fit. The minimalist design is highlighted by breathable open-toe construction and a soft top layer on the footbed. Strategic groove placement on the outsole yields an aggressive sawtooth traction pattern, good for a combination of grip and impact protection.
